name: Mexico City & Bogotá — Teotihuacán, Centro Histórico, Xochimilco & the Andes

stops.name: Dallas/Fort Worth Airport
stops.notes: Arrived 3 hrs before the evening flight. Dinner in the airport lounge.

stops.name: Mexico City International Airport
stops.notes: Terminal 1, landed 10:45 PM. Withdrew pesos at an ATM in the arrivals hall.

stops.name: Parral 14 Boutique Hotel
stops.notes: Condesa. Uber from the airport, checked in late. 5-night stay.

stops.name: Teotihuacán
stops.notes: Pyramids tour (Viator / Experiencias Mexicanas) with tequila tasting. Pickup at Churrería El Moro.

stops.name: La Gruta Restaurant
stops.notes: Cave restaurant, lunch on the tour. Chicken with mole and chiles en nogada.

stops.name: Parral 14 Boutique Hotel
stops.notes: Evening walk around Condesa before calling it a night.

extras.name: Azul Condesa
extras.notes: Dinner: chapulines, D'Amaro liquor with guacamole, artisanal tortillas, salsa roja.

stops.name: Zócalo
stops.notes: Took the Metro into the centre and back, just to try it. Self-guided day.

stops.name: National Palace
stops.notes: Diego Rivera murals.

stops.name: Mercado de San Juan
stops.notes: Lunch at a street-side stall: huarache with chorizo and cecina, agua de rompope.

stops.name: Parral 14 Boutique Hotel
stops.notes: Self-guided worked, but a guide for the museums would have added depth.

extras.name: Barrio Chino (Chinatown)
extras.notes: Found en route, unplanned, along with a couple of free museums.

extras.name: La Isla Bonita
extras.notes: Seafood dinner close to the hotel. Squid in ink sauce, fancy piña colada, whole fish in garlic oil.

stops.name: Coyoacán (Jardín Centenario / Plaza Hidalgo)
stops.notes: Day tour with Amigo Tours.

stops.name: UNAM murals (Ciudad Universitaria)
stops.notes: Diego Rivera / Juan O'Gorman murals, UNESCO site.

stops.name: Xochimilco
stops.notes: Trajinera canal ride.

stops.name: Casa Azul (Museo Frida Kahlo)
stops.notes: No live guide inside — used the tour's digital PDF guide instead.

stops.name: Parral 14 Boutique Hotel
stops.notes: Tour ran later than expected — back ~6:30 PM.

extras.name: Restaurant next to Casa Azul
extras.notes: Lunch — better choice than the tour's buffet add-on. Octopus tacos, agua de horchata.

extras.name: La Isla Bonita
extras.notes: Dinner, second visit. Mango mezcalita, spicy shrimp, squid in ink sauce.

stops.name: Bosque de Chapultepec & Chapultepec Castle
stops.notes: Castle, park and museum done via Ecobici by 11 AM — left ~8:15 AM.

stops.name: Colonia Roma Food Tour meeting point (KAAJ)
stops.notes: Sabores Mexico, 12–4 PM. Fish tacos, Oaxacan cuisine, mezcal, specialty coffee, cocktails. Worth it for the curation and the guide's insight into Roma Norte.

extras.name: W Repostería
extras.notes: Tres leches cake (the food tour guide's tip) — too full for a real dinner. Then an hour-long mezcal tasting on production and varieties: a great close to the Mexico City leg.

stops.name: Mexico City International Airport
stops.notes: Terminal 2. Early Uber for the 8:50 AM flight to Bogotá.

stops.name: El Dorado Airport, Bogotá
stops.notes: Landed 2:40 PM. Rough Friday-evening traffic on the transfer in.

stops.name: Bogotá 100 Design Hotel by Sarasti
stops.notes: Calle 100 area. 3-night stay.

stops.name: Museo del Oro (Gold Museum)
stops.notes: Made it in the evening despite the traffic.

extras.name: Bakery near Museo del Oro
extras.notes: Informal dinner given the traffic-heavy day.

stops.name: Guatavita town
stops.notes: "Zipaquirá & Guatavita Lake: Top 5 Sights" tour (GetYourGuide / Bogota Travel Experience), rebooked the night before after the original shared tour was cancelled. Pickup ~8:50 AM; beautiful drive. First stop, ~20 min — handmade souvenir shops.

stops.name: Laguna de Guatavita
stops.notes: Hike up in some rain, hummingbirds along the way. Queso arepa shared with the docile dogs at the stops. Good coffee.

stops.name: Restaurant in Guatavita town
stops.notes: Lunch — expensive, decent food.

stops.name: Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral
stops.notes: A highlight of the day.

stops.name: Bogotá 100 Design Hotel by Sarasti
stops.notes: Back by 8:30 PM. Dinner: Ukiyo takeout.

stops.name: Bogota Bike Tours (Bicycle City Tour)
stops.notes: 10:30 AM–3 PM by bike: Paloquemao Market (cut in planning, seen anyway), a coffee tasting (bought beans), riding the Ciclovía itself, and stumbling onto the Bogotá Day parades.

stops.name: Fulanitos 95
stops.notes: Chapinero location (the La Candelaria one had permanently closed). Very heavy lunch — a meat/sausage dish rather than the fish expected.

stops.name: Usaquén Market (Mercado de las Pulgas)
stops.notes: ~1.5 hrs. Stalls were shutting down by 6 PM despite Google Maps showing a 7 PM close.

stops.name: Bogotá 100 Design Hotel by Sarasti
stops.notes: Walked back to the hotel, then out again to the spa.

stops.name: Spa des Elements
stops.notes: 1-hour massage, 112,000 COP, wrapped up ~8:30 PM.

stops.name: Bogotá 100 Design Hotel by Sarasti
stops.notes: Light dinner: a dulce de leche dessert, given how heavy lunch had been.

extras.name: Paloquemao Market
extras.notes: Fruit and flower market, covered on the bike tour.

extras.name: Andrés DC
extras.notes: Booked, then cancelled — beef-heavy and drifts into a late bar/nightlife scene, neither a fit.

stops.name: Chorro de Quevedo (Walking Tour)
stops.notes: Gran Colombia Tours, 10 AM–1 PM. Swapped from the Graffiti Tour for a proper guided historical walk.

stops.name: Monserrate
stops.notes: Walked over from lunch, arrived ~2:30 PM. The funicular was down (cable car only), so took the Fast Pass — saved 30 min–1 hr of queueing. Bird trail open with no booking needed; spotted hummingbirds. Stayed a couple of hours.

stops.name: Museo Botero
stops.notes: Open Mondays, recommended by the walking tour guide. Enjoyed Botero's style. There until 6:15 PM.

stops.name: El Dorado Airport, Bogotá
stops.notes: Long lines; check-in took a while (passport needed in-person verification). Waited out the 11:55 PM flight in the El Dorado Lounge.

stops.name: Boston Logan Airport
stops.notes: Arrived 7:10 AM on Aug 25. Trip complete.

extras.name: Bounce luggage storage (Delgadillo Hotel by Socialtel)
extras.notes: Dropped the bag at 9:30 AM, picked it up ~6:15 PM — serendipitously right next to Museo Botero.

extras.name: Contraste Coffee Lab / Varietale
extras.notes: Coffee option in La Candelaria before heading to the airport.

extras.name: Puebla day trip
extras.notes: Colonial city, Talavera pottery, birthplace of chiles en nogada — cut for pacing.

extras.name: Lucha Libre
extras.notes: Evening wrestling event — cut for pacing.

extras.name: Museo Anahuacalli
extras.notes: Diego Rivera's pyramid-shaped museum, pre-Hispanic art collection.

extras.name: Jardín Botánico de Bogotá
extras.notes: Calmer alternative to Usaquén's Sunday crowds.

extras.name: Parque Simón Bolívar
extras.notes: Large park, low-key local Sunday option.
